about: Everything kept so far from the spec's brainstorms, in one place, and from round 11 on the source. The world (round 13): a generic world by depth, with regions, transitions and themed areas set in it (round 12). 'parts' are round 8's places, each now inside one of these; 'fits' on places, monsters and strangers name parts. Fits of monsters and strangers are proposals, to be culled region by region. The game will load its content from data like this.

regions.line: Generic, generated by depth: today's grounds carried deeper (built, collapsed, caves, deeper still). About half a run.
